title: CodeStorm 2026: 48-Hour National Hackathon
organizer: Student Tech Committee & ACM Student Chapter
description: Collaborate in teams of 2 to 4 to build innovative Web, Cloud, or AI solutions addressing real-world university and community challenges with grand prizes.

title: Hands-on Workshop: Relational Query Optimization & Indexing
description: Deep-dive into SQL execution plans, B-Tree index structures, subquery tuning, and multi-table join performance in enterprise databases.

title: Seminar: Future of Edge Computing and Network Protocols
description: Keynote address by industry experts examining 5G/6G transport protocols, IoT edge infrastructure, and decentralized routing topologies.

title: Campus Cultural Fest: Spectrum 2026
description: Celebrate campus talent with music performances, drama, dance battles, art exhibits, and food stalls from across different states.

title: Inter-Department Cricket & Badminton Tournament
description: Annual sports championship featuring knock-out matches between Engineering, IT, Management, and Science departments.

title: Full-Stack Web Dev Bootcamp: REST APIs & Asynchronous JS
description: Intensive hands-on lab on modern Fetch API, Promises, async/await, DOM updates, and building reactive single-page user experiences.

title: Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking Symposium
description: Learn network vulnerability analysis, web application penetration testing, OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, and security best practices.

title: Resume Building & Technical Interview Prep Session
description: Career guidance on crafting industry-ready resumes, tackling Data Structures and Algorithms interview questions, and mock interviews.

title: Robotics & Microcontroller Exhibition (RoboFest)
description: Exhibition of line follower robots, obstacle avoidance rovers, automated quadcopters, and IoT smart home sensor arrays.

title: Alumni Mentorship Circle: Transitioning from College to Tech Industry
description: Distinguished alumni from leading tech enterprises share their career roadmap, lessons learned, and recommendations for juniors.

title: Cloud Computing & AWS Architecture Essentials
description: Understand cloud compute instances, S3 object storage, serverless functions, VPC networking, and cost estimation fundamentals.

title: Campus Photography & Creative Media Exhibition
description: Annual visual art showcase featuring student photography, digital graphic illustrations, short film screenings, and portfolio critique.
